title: Blinded Dual-Track Dissection of Homodimer Biophysics, Neural Splicing, and Diploid Stoichiometry Across Human DYNC1H1 (Release v2.0.0 / Step 4 Curated)

creators.name: Cirak, Sebahattin
creators.affiliation: University Medical Center [Placeholder: Insert Exact Affiliation]

description: Complete frozen evaluation tables (11,892 observed GRCh38 human DYNC1H1 alleles on NM_001376.5 / NP_001367.2), polymer-validated clash-free 2x4,646-AA Off-Phi and On-Active-DDA homodimer coordinates, 16 dihedral-scanned OpenMM (Amber14SB + GBn2) wild-type and mutant clinical pocket structures, row-curated published patient phenotypes (Table S3 & Table 4, n=130), compiled GRCh38 UCSC Genome Browser binary Track Hub (bigBed 9 / bigWig), interactive 3Dmol.js Web Explorer, and reproducible Python/Colab code.
